ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allows taking photos of a church building to suggest or verify a church in the directory and scanning hymn or church QR codes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allows attaching existing photos from your photo library when updating your profile photo or suggesting a church in the directory.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allows finding verified El Buen Pastor churches near your location.
